column1: # Columns and semantics match manifests/harness.tsv (FG-091): this profile
# owns the top-level `suites/policy` area and pins its exact release
# surface by full-corpus suite id. Set equality is enforced against discovery:
# no missing, no unregistered, no renamed alias.
#   suite_id           the id run_all derives from the script path
#   owning_bead        the capability bead that owns the suite
#   gate               the gate/profile this entry belongs to
#   proof_class        what a pass establishes, in claim-lattice terms
#   expected_terminal  the terminal status a pass must carry
